messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: prod-west-1 GPU queue growth > 5m threshold. Autoscaler attempted 3 scale-ups, failures detected. Paging #oncall :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: ack, jumping in. seeing high pending pods in inference namespace. starting triage.

alex-m: fyi customers hitting slower gen times, we got alerts from customer-metrics too.

sre-oncall: checked queue: `inference-requests > 12k`, token churn high, average wait 18s. kubectl snapshot coming.

eng-runtime: paste kube pending list? I want pod reasons.

sre-oncall: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Pending` shows ~120 pending. sample reasons: `0/0 nodes available: Insufficient gpu, node(s) didn't match Pod's nodeAffinity.` Some show `0/12 nodes are available: 6 Insufficient gpu, 6 node(s) had taint {gpu-driver=bad:NoSchedule}`

maria-g: autoscaler-bot logs?

autoscaler-bot: autoscaler event: scaleUp: group=kube-gpu-pool desired=40 -> 44 attempted, blocked by provider error: `InvalidInstanceCapacity: capacity-constraint - quota exceeded for GPU family` then `AttachLaunchTemplateFailed: launch template version mismatch`.

infra-lead: okay two separate things: cloud quota preventing new p4/p3 launches; and launch template mismatch causing new instances not to join correctly.

support-jess: any known customer impact? support is getting tickets reporting 502/timeout on inference endpoints. severity: elevated. Notifying sales for impacted accounts.

alex-m: quick mitigation idea: scale down non-critical batch workloads consuming GPUs, cordon some test pools to free quota, and try fallback nodegroup with older launch template that is known-good.

sre-oncall: trying immediate mitigations:
- `kubectl -n batch scale deployment batch-trainer --replicas=0`
- patching HPA for experimental-infer to 0
- cordon test-gpu-1 pool
All executed, reclaiming ~8 GPUs.

sre-oncall: still ~90 pending. autoscaler still failing on launch template attach: `InstanceProfileNotFound` in cloud provider logs; looks like the LT points to instanceProfile arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/ri-gpu-profile-v2 which is missing in prod account.

infra-lead: that explains some nodes spinning but never joining. who pushed LT change? eng-runtime?

eng-runtime: recent rollout last night updated launch template to include SSM and new instance profile for KMS access. we tested in canary but didn't promote properly. we have the manifest.

maria-g: can we revert LT to v3 which worked last week? that needs infra permission.

infra-lead: I can create a temporary instance-profile alias matching the ARN used by LT to let instances attach. Doing that now as emergency fix.

incident-bot: ACTION TAKEN: temp instance-profile ri-gpu-profile-v2 created at 2167894520 by infra-lead.

sre-oncall: after profile creation, ASG started launching, but new nodes show `kernel module error` and are tainted: `gpu-driver=bad:NoSchedule`. `kubectl describe node ip-10-0-12-34` shows kubelet OOM and `nvidia-driver mismatch: required 525.x, found 470.x`. Nodes are joining but not usable.

eng-runtime: ah, the AMI used in the LT is an older GPU AMI. That explains the driver mismatch. our canary LT used new AMI; prod LT somehow rolled older AMI.

sre-oncall: plan B: spin up a small emergency nodegroup with the canary-backed LT/AMI (gpu-canary-group) but the autoscaler is set to not touch that group. We can create nodes manually via ASG increase to get immediate capacity.

infra-lead: I can increase desired count on gpu-canary-group by +6 manually. Doing it now.

autoscaler-bot: note: gpu-canary-group has tag `aws:autoscaling:force=false` so autoscaler won't target it. manual scale accepted.

support-jess: customers still seeing degraded responses, several high-priority accounts on hold. Communicating ETA ~30m as we bring nodes up.

sre-oncall: new canary nodes are registering, drivers match, pods scheduling onto them. reclaiming queue now. observed latency drop from 18s -> 5s for scheduled pods.

maria-g: good. next, we need to fix autoscaler LT mismatch and quota. Two longer fixes:
- update prod launch template to point to canary AMI + correct instance-profile
- request GPU quota increase with cloud support (we're hitting family-level quota)
Either will take hours.

eng-runtime: I'll open a PR to update LT and coordinate with infra for safe rollout and canary.

infra-lead: filing support ticket with cloud provider for quota bump now (case 87654321). Also raising ASG max size from 50 -> 80 as interim (requires approvals).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: manual canary nodegroup scale + LT temp profile fixed immediate customer impact. Autoscaler still blocked until LT and quota fixes are completed.

sre-oncall: handoff to infra-lead for quota and LT push. I'll stay for postmortem but un-assigning pager in 30m if no regressions.

support-jess: sending customer status update now: "We're seeing degraded performance due to GPU capacity constraints; mitigation in progress; estimated recovery 30-45 minutes."

alex-m: thumbs up. follow-ups: add CI check to prevent LT/instance-profile drift, add runbook step to create emergency nodegroup with validated AMI.

maria-g: also add alert for `AttachLaunchTemplateFailed` and `InstanceProfileNotFound` in autoscaler logs. Those would have pointed to this sooner.

infra-lead: noting action items in incident doc. Will update when quota ticket responds.

sre-oncall: closing active panic: queue trending down. Will mark incident as "mitigated" and start RCA doc next. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
